output: Arrr, me hearty! For dinner, ye could try some hearty stew with chunks of meat and vegetables, washed down with a good swig of rum. Or perhaps a platter of fish and chips, served up with a side of tartar sauce. And don't forget a slice of pie for dessert, to cap off the meal perfectly! But remember, in these parts, fresh seafood is always a hit, so if ye can find some fresh fish or shellfish, that would be a fine choice as well.
